I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of the said Act.

Allotments, depicted in the Advance Tracing No. Maha/AKR/2023/286 of 15.06.2023 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in Dunuwila Village in the Village Oﬃ cer's Division No. 578- Dunuwila North in Udagampaha Korale Minor division in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Akurana in Kandy District of Central Province and bounded as follows with following name and extent:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Pendentent Watta – About Extent: 0.100 Hectare North and East: PendententWatta Claimed by the Chief Incumbent monk of Degaldoruwa Rajamaha Viharaya temple; South: PendententWatta Claimed by the Chief Incumbent Monk of Degaldoruwa Rajamaha Viharaya temple and Lot B; West: Lot B and PendententWatta Claimed by the Cheif Incumbent Monk of Degaldoruwa Rajamaha Viharaya temple.

02. Lot ‘B’ – Pendentent Watta – About Extent: 0.0111 Hectare North: PendententWatta claimed by the Chief incumbent monk of Degaldoruwa Rajamaha Viharaya temple and Lot A; East: PendententWatta claimed by the Chief Incumbent monk of Degaldoruwa Rajamaha Viharaya temple; South: PendententWatta claimed by the Chief incumbent Monk of Degaldoruwa Rajamaha Viharaya temple and Road; West: PendententWatta claimed by the Chief Incumbent Monk of Degaldoruwa Rajamaha Viharaya temple.
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
